Consent.Headline: “{0}” wants to connect to this Mac
Consent.Headline.Windows: “{0}” wants to connect to this PC
Consent.Intro: If you allow, they can see and use this Mac with the permissions you select. Deny if you don't recognize them.
Consent.Intro.Windows: If you allow, they can see and use this PC with the permissions you select. Deny if you don't recognize them.
Consent.FingerprintLabel: Their key fingerprint (to check it, ask them to read out “This Mac's fingerprint” from their window)
Consent.Takeover: This Mac is being controlled by another device. If you allow, that session will end.
Consent.Takeover.Windows: This PC is being controlled by another device. If you allow, that session will end.
Consent.PermClipboard: Sync clipboard (what is copied on either side is shared)
Consent.PermAudio: Send sound (sound playing on this Mac plays on their side)
Consent.PermAudio.Windows: Send sound (sound playing on this PC plays on their side)
Consent.PermFile: Transfer files (only the side that has a file can send it)
Consent.SaveDevice: Remember this device (no code needed next time, but you still confirm)
Consent.SkipNextTime: Don't ask again when this device connects
Consent.SkipNextTimeNote: When on, they can connect even while you are away from the computer; a banner always stays at the top of the screen.
Consent.InputAvailable: Can move the mouse, click and type
Consent.InputUnavailable: NexaDesk does not have Accessibility permission on this Mac, so keyboard and mouse cannot be allowed
Consent.FileNote: Both sides can send each other files, and received files are saved in {0}; they cannot browse files on this Mac
Consent.FileNote.Windows: Both sides can send each other files, and received files are saved in {0}; they cannot browse files on this PC
Consent.Countdown: Denied automatically if there is no answer within {0} s
Consent.HeadlineBrowser: The browser “{0}” wants to connect to this Mac
Consent.HeadlineBrowser.Windows: The browser “{0}” wants to connect to this PC
Consent.BrowserNote: This is a web browser, not the NexaDesk app. It can see the screen, use the keyboard and mouse, and, if you tick it, exchange copied text. It is never saved.
Consent.HeadlineAgent: The AI agent “{0}” wants to connect to this Mac
Consent.HeadlineAgent.Windows: The AI agent “{0}” wants to connect to this PC
Consent.AgentNote: This is an AI agent: a program, not a person. If you allow it, it can see the screen and use the keyboard and mouse on its own. The banner shows it is an AI for as long as it is connected, and you can disconnect it at any time. Only allow it if you started it yourself or were expecting it.
Consent.UnverifiedNote: They entered no one-time code or password, only your device ID, so nothing proves who they are. Allow only if you are expecting them.
Consent.TerminalNote: They can run any command on this Mac as you. Only for people you trust.
Consent.TerminalNote.Windows: They can run any command on this PC as you. Only for people you trust.
